sources.title: MiniMax H3 AI Video Generator: Create Videos with Sound
sources.snippet: MiniMax H3 is a new-generation general-purpose multimodal video model. Instead of treating image, video, and audio tasks separately, H3 understands text, images, video clips, and audio together as one creative context, then generates coherent videos with native stereo sound.

sources.snippet: Official Hub for MiniMax H3 (minimaxh3.run) — An all-in-one open-source resource platform for MiniMax H3 (Hailuo AI 3.0), the state-of-the-art native multi-modal 2K AI video generation model with synchronized 3D stereo audio.
